title: Jak 2 (Sony PlayStation 2, 2003) PS2 Tested Works Manual CIB Video Game
descriptionText:
Experience the thrilling action and adventure of Jak II, a game released for the Sony PlayStation 2 in 2003. This game, rated T for Teen, follows the story of Jak, a young man who is transported to a world where he is a slave. Jak must fight his way through various challenges and obstacles to uncover the truth about his past and save the world from evil forces. 

This complete in box (CIB) video game comes with a manual and has been tested to ensure that it works perfectly. It is compatible with NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region codes and is published by Sony. Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with Jak II and discover the secrets of his past!
